long_biography.plain_text:
Hall's connection to wine began in her parents' Mendocino vineyard, which she managed with her brother for a decade. Her wider career moved through municipal law in Berkeley, affirmative-action work at Safeway, inner-city development and a partnership at Hall Financial Group. She later represented the United States in Austria from 1997 to 2001.

After returning to California winemaking, Kathryn and Craig Hall developed HALL Wines around Napa Cabernet Sauvignon and added two further labels. Kathryn remains a proprietor of the three wine businesses. She has sustained civic work through the North Texas Food Bank, nonprofit boards and the couple's foundation. Craig separately founded and chairs HALL Group, whose real-estate, lending and investment businesses sit outside Kathryn's wine-company operating role.
